system.description: The character can make mirages appear in a target's mind.
system.effect: The character creates a full-sensory mirage that affects any target with whom they have established a link. The mirage can be of anything the character desires, and it can move freely,

outcomes.label: Describe the full-sensory mirage and confirm an established telepathic link with the selected target. The mirage can move freely while concentration continues.
